<thought>From the mass spectrum the most intense peak is at m/z ≈ 199 with a characteristic Br isotopic pattern (199/201 ≈ 1:1). Assuming this is the protonated ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral mass is 199 − 1.007276 ≈ 197.992 Da. Subtracting the monoisotopic mass of ⁷⁹Br (78.918 Da) leaves 119.074 Da, which matches the exact mass of C₈H₉N (119.0735 Da) within < 1 mDa. Therefore the molecular formula that fits the observed mass and the bromine isotopic pattern is C₈H₉BrN.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H9BrN</final_answer>
